name: Wuxi Boton Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Boton Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in conveyor belt manufacturing, conveyor system technical services, and mobile online game operations in China and internationally. It operates through Conveyor Belt Manufacturing, Conveyor System Technical Services, Investment Services, and Mobile Game Operations segments. The company offers industrial bulk material conveyor belts; conveying system products, including conveyor belt operation monitoring systems, conveyor operation monitoring systems, cleaning robots, naked-eye 3D display devices, and other products; software services; and operation services.
